name: Vacuum Cleaner vs. Broom
instruction: Design a 3D model comparing a vacuum cleaner and a broom. The vacuum cleaner should have a cylindrical body with a hose and a nozzle, while the broom should have a long handle with bristles at the end. Position them side by side.

Shape accuracy: The vacuum cleaner has a cylindrical body.
The vacuum cleaner includes a hose.
The vacuum cleaner has a nozzle.
The broom has a long handle.
The broom features bristles at the end.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The vacuum cleaner's hose should be appropriately sized relative to the body.
The broom's bristles should be proportionate to the length of the handle.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The vacuum cleaner is positioned next to the broom.
The hose of the vacuum cleaner should not obstruct the broom.
The bristles of the broom are clearly visible at the end of the handle.
Object distance and contact: There is a clear space between the vacuum cleaner and the broom.
The vacuum cleaner and broom are not overlapping.
The nozzle of the vacuum cleaner is directed away from the broom.

Instruction execution accuracy: Both the vacuum cleaner and broom are accurately represented.
The positioning of the objects side by side is correctly executed.
